programme.title: Wicked

Part one of The Wizard of Oz prequel based on the hit stage musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande-Butera, Jonathan Bailey, Michelle Yeoh and Jeff Goldblum.

programme.desc: Dracula opens a luxury resort for monsters, to provide a refuge from terrified humans. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg.

programme.desc: Dracula is worried that his half-human grandson is not showing any vampiric tendencies, so enlists the help of his fellow monsters in showing the youngster how it is done.
